# `adt ls`

List ABAP objects in repository

```bash
adt ls [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                  | Description                                              | Default |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`                | Output as JSON                                           |         |
| `-t, --type <types>`    | Filter by object type (comma-separated, e.g., CLAS,INTF) |         |
| `-o, --output <file>`   | Write output to file                                     |         |
| `-d, --dir <directory>` | Directory to scan (default: current directory)           |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
